description: This file defines CRUD API endpoints for credential management in a FastAPI application. It includes classes and functions for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting credentials, as well as utility functions for encrypting credential values and internal logic for merging credentials. The code interacts with external modules for database access, logging, encryption, and proxy handling.
